summary: Prefer specific verbs over weak ones like is, are, occur or happen, and avoid starting sentences with 'There is' or 'It is'.
questions: Should I start sentences with 'There are'?

answer_card.title: Precise verbs
answer_card.answer_md: Use specific verbs instead of "is", "are", "occur", "happen". Start with a real subject rather than "There is/are" or "It is".
